name: pi-starline
notes: Forked from Andy8647/pi-starline. The shared mouse API contract lives in openspec/specs/mouse-api; fork behavior and releases are documented in the package README and FORK-CHANGELOG.

knownDebt.reason: The upstream identity assertion must distinguish the fork OIDC repository URL from upstream homepage/bugs/image references. Keep this assertion adaptation while fork publishing uses xzzpig/pi-extensions.

Fork npm publication must identify xzzpig/pi-extensions as repository.url for OIDC provenance; upstream identity remains in this subtree record and package homepage. This minimal metadata divergence remains while publishing the fork.
The minimal fork-only cursor adapter call is needed for underline and terminal cursor styles on Pi 1.2+ while preserving Pi 1.1 behavior. Remove it when upstream supports both cursor encodings.

Fork release packaging adds declaration build/prepack scripts and dist plus fork release notes to upstream's extensions/types allowlist. Required by the repository publish contract; removable if upstream adopts the same declaration distribution.
The lockfile root identity and version track the independently published fork and are updated mechanically with npm. Remove this divergence if the upstream lockfile is no longer retained.

The exact published-files assertion follows the intentional fork allowlist including declarations and fork release notes, without relaxing runtime assertions. Reconcile when upstream changes its packaging contract.

The mouse consumer, pointer delegation and adapted upstream integration tests intentionally use pi-mouse-events rather than upstream's separate renderer patches. Keep until upstream adopts a compatible shared mouse API.

The editor factory, frame splitter and prototype registry retain pi-zentui legacy aliases removed upstream so the two packages can coexist in either load order. Remove only when legacy coexistence is no longer supported.
Use Function.prototype.apply.call to preserve predecessor dispatch while satisfying the local no-Reflect.apply rule; remove if upstream adopts equivalent forwarding or the rule changes.

Retain the user-message renderer and its configuration, tests and documentation after upstream moved that responsibility to pi-tidy. Both load orders were tested with pi-tidy v0.5.0; isolated rendering shows the visible renderer can depend on patch order. Document pi-tidy userMessageStyle off for users who want Starline styling.

The generic prototype-patch boundary accepts object targets, forwards predecessor calls and returns unknown because it handles multiple unrelated Pi methods. Its reported lint findings are unchanged from the pre-sync fork; preserve the existing behavior under the current-change-only policy.
The usage-entry double cast is unchanged in both the pre-sync fork and upstream v0.9.0; keep inherited source bytes under the current-change-only policy.
The existing fork mouse API version guard triggers one biome useOptionalChain warning; retain its current behavior for this cursor-compatibility release.
The upstream-identical pill click test triggers one biome noConfusingVoidType warning; keep its upstream bytes to avoid an unrelated fork edit.
9 lint/style/noNonNullAssertion warnings on an upstream test file, kept by deliberate non-change: warnings do not fail biome check and fixing them would add fork edits inside an upstream file.
2 lint/suspicious/noConfusingVoidType warnings on an upstream test file, kept by deliberate non-change for the same reason.

reapplyOnSync: Adapt test/package-identity.test.ts to assert repository.url identifies xzzpig/pi-extensions while upstream homepage/bugs/image references remain Andy8647/pi-starline.
Keep package.json repository.url at git+https://github.com/xzzpig/pi-extensions.git for fork OIDC publishing; retain upstream source identity in subtree metadata.
editor-cursor.ts calls fork-editor-cursor.ts to restyle Pi 1.2+ marked software cursors while retaining the upstream Pi 1.1 SGR path; retain fork-editor-cursor-compat.test.ts

mouse features register with the local @xzzpig/pi-mouse-events extension instead of patching TuiAltScreen.prototype (optional peer >=0.2.0 <3, devDep workspace:*); without it fork mouse features are off, with one console note per process; click-away observes shared mouse events and the optional shared pointer API handles hover without a Starline patch
mouse/api-consumer.ts reads Symbol.for('pi-mouse-events.api.v2') and rejects any candidate whose version !== 2, so an older v1 publisher is rejected rather than misread
keep test/contract/mouse-api.test.ts pinning that key plus the version:1 rejection fixture
every git probe in extensions/starline/git.ts passes --no-optional-locks (test/git-no-optional-locks.test.ts)
test/runtime.test.ts passes an explicit empty env to detectRuntime so ambient Nix markers cannot shadow file-marker fixtures
keep the comment-only additions: ui.ts SAFETY/pi-lens-ignore notes and config.ts's empty-catch note

Keep package.json TAB-indented with the fork name/version/dependencies, declaration build:types/prepack scripts, and files allowlist (extensions, dist, types, FORK-CHANGELOG.md). Keep the upstream package-identity test aligned; regenerate the package-lock root identity mechanically with npm, never by hand.

mouse/index.ts stays the fork's consumer-API rewrite; use the optional shared asynchronous copy slot for Pi's native clipboard and retain the synchronous OSC 52 fallback for older v2 publishers; prefer the shared post-component wheel slot and Pi's computed delta, falling back to the older pre-dispatch slot when unavailable
preserve pi-zentui legacy symbol interoperability in editor-factory-marker.ts, ui.ts and prototype-patch-registry.ts and retain test/legacy-symbols.test.ts when upstream removes the aliases
delegate mouse/pointer-shape.ts requests to the shared pointer coordinator; keep the fork pill-mouse observer and adapt upstream external-layer and clipboard tests to the shared consumer architecture
keep typed pointer-shape prototype and safe Function.prototype.apply.call forwarding in pointer-shape.ts and queue-rows.ts when upstream changes these methods
keep clickToToggleExpandable (default true) across the config.ts sites and the test files; clickToExpandTools is not restored anywhere

keep handlesMouse() deleted, mouse/hit-test.ts at fork HEAD, key-text.ts at upstream bytes as the single source with tool-box.ts/index.ts importing keyTextFor from ./key-text, and capabilities.ts's D8 type tightening (<T extends object>)
keep Pi peer ranges >=1.0.0 <2 with catalog devDependencies; retain the optional pi-mouse-events v2 API contract

Preserve the user-message renderer deleted by upstream: retain its configuration fields and settings command, install and register its render/invalidate adapters, preserve the fork user-message tests and documentation, and use fork-transcript-copy.ts for configured rails alongside pi-tidy cleaning.

pill.ts picks the pill text colour from the 256-colour cube (TEXT_DARK 38;5;16, TEXT_LIGHT 38;5;231) instead of the basic ANSI codes 30/97, whose values the terminal theme owns; a background on the terminal's own 16 colours is painted in reverse video via the fork-only fork-pill-legibility.ts (isTerminalOwnedBackground/reverseVideoSgr), with one seam each in pill.ts (PreparedPill.reverse, body and thin-divider prefixes) and pill-bubble.ts (selected row); an explicit fg: token (hasExplicitForeground) always keeps the user's colour and never reverses. Re-apply those seams and the matching assertions in test/pill.test.ts and test/pill-click.test.ts; test/fork-pill-contrast.test.ts covers the fork behaviour.

index.ts imports installMcpPillAdapter from ./fork-mcp-pill and calls it immediately after publishPillApi(), which is the whole seam: the module owns the session_start/session_shutdown handlers, registers the default `mcp` pill action through registerExternalPillAction (builtin PILL_ACTIONS stays untouched) and dispatches the adapter's own /mcp-adapter command. Keep extensions/starline/fork-mcp-pill.ts, test/fork-mcp-pill.test.ts and test/fork-mcp-status-render.test.ts, and the FORK-CHANGELOG.md entry describing the compact-text premise and the bounded reopen guard.

pill-config.ts carries the overflow block: PillConfig gains `overflow: PillOverflowConfig`, DEFAULT_PILL_CONFIG includes `overflow: DEFAULT_PILL_OVERFLOW`, and normalizePillConfig calls normalizePillOverflow(value.overflow) (returning a fresh normalized block when pill is absent). Re-apply those three seams; the normalizer and its defaults stay in fork-overflow-config.ts.

config.ts exports savePillOverflowPatch, which merges a patch into the raw `pill.overflow` record through applyOverflowPatch from fork-overflow-config.ts so unknown keys survive a settings save. Re-apply the import plus that one function.

footer.ts keeps the governed row behind one seam: the render tail builds legacyPillInputs (the unchanged collectPillInputs call at its original indentation), calls renderStatusBar from fork-status-bar.ts, publishes the panel model with publishStatusPanelModel, and stores the returned hit map per width. handleMouse resolves the private OVERFLOW_SUMMARY_KEY pill and shortened read-only pills through openStatusPanel while leaving every registered action first; dispose publishes no model and closes the panel. Re-apply those call sites and keep the surrounding label/colour code byte-stable.

settings-command.ts keeps only call-sized seams for the settings surface: the Layout tab splices ...overflowLayoutItems(config), the extension-segments tab splices ...overflowStatusItems({config, key, statusSettingPrefix}) per published status, the change handler hands every id to applyOverflowSetting(...) once, and the `/starline statuses` route is one handleStatusPanelCommand(args, ctx) call before the unknown-argument warning. The rows, value lists, presets, id parsing for priority/pinned and the close-then-mount ordering all live in extensions/starline/fork-overflow-settings.ts — re-apply the seams, not the logic, and keep every surrounding upstream line byte-stable.

index.ts wires the fork sources with two calls: configureStatusView({ getConfig: getCurrentConfig, getStatuses: () => getActiveExtensionStatuses() }) in installUi and configureStatusView(undefined) in cleanupUi, plus a setPillOverflow dep that assigns savePillOverflowPatch(patch) to currentConfig. Keep those seams minimal.

docs/configuration.md keeps only the added pointer subsection ("Overflow, when the bar runs out of room") before "Segment display options"; every other line stays at upstream bytes. Do not run a formatter over this file — it re-wraps the segments example and a nested bullet that upstream wrote differently.
doNotReintroduce: Do not restore upstream repository.url as the fork publishing source; npm provenance must identify the actual build repository.

expect recurring modify/delete conflicts on every pull: upstream deleted these files and the fork keeps them — extensions/starline/mouse/tool-box.ts, mouse/component-tree.ts, test/contract/tool-box-hint.test.ts, test/mouse/tool-box.test.ts, test/mouse/component-tree.test.ts, test/contract/transcript-layout.test.ts
keep editor-wheel.test.ts's 9 lint/style warnings and shim.ts's 2 noConfusingVoidType warnings by deliberate non-change
Do not restore the removed editor metadata row or its settings; use the upstream compact editor and map legacy editor status placement to the footer right.

Do not restore the pre-overflow single-row cut as the default when the segments do not fit: the governed bar (content caps, retention prefix, +N) is the default and `pill.overflow.enabled: false` is only an explicit opt-out. Unbounded wrapping stays out; a two-line mode is a separate change with its own anchor and hit-test work.
